predictions.articleTitle: Portugal vs Denmark Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Ramos Lead Post-Ronaldo Attack? — xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Portugal's superior shot volume and intact midfield spine support a full-time Home Win in an open Over 2.5 contest against a Christensen-less Denmark defense.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis (Core): Home Win driven by Portugal's 18.5 shots per match and Vitinha-Bruno Fernandes central control against Denmark's makeshift central defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle (Value): Over 2.5 Goals targeting 2:1 and 3:1 supported by a 3.38 combined lambda and 65.6% Poisson Over 2.5 probability (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle (Hedge / Upset): 1:1 Draw if Portugal's 50.0% big-chance waste rate stalls the post-Ronaldo frontline and Denmark convert set-piece chances (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Post-Ronaldo Portugal host Christensen-less Denmark in Braga.

spf.comment: Portugal's 1.75 xG per game and midfield continuity point to a 2:1 home victory over Denmark's patched backline.

over_under.comment: A 3.38 combined lambda, 64.7% Poisson BTTS rate, and full-back/CB absences on both sides point above 2.5 goals.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Portugal's control alongside defensive concessions, while 3:1 captures late space if Denmark chase points.

goals.comment: Poisson totals peak at 3 goals (21.9%) and 4 goals (18.5%), matching both sides' open Nations League scoring averages.

bqc.comment: Portugal led at HT in 3 of 4 group games (Win-Win), while a cautious post-Ronaldo opening favors Draw-Win.
